data.name: Aniruddhsinh
data.long_meaning: Ani- (Ani- Rudra) meaning 'Rudra's', Sinh- (Sinh Asvatthama) meaning 'Lion'. The name Aniruddhsinh is a combination of Aniruddha and Sinh. Aniruddha is a name of Lord Krishna who was the son of Lord Krishna and Rukmini. Sinh is a royal and powerful name derived from the lion. This name suggests the strength and courage of a king and the wisdom of a god.
